verdict.rationale: Grafana documents ad-hoc exploration of telemetry: Explore supports ad-hoc queries, drilldown and side-by-side comparison, and you can query metrics, logs and traces wherever they are stored. The stack also has a documented query language, LogQL for Loki logs. Community reports of trouble finding log exploration and thin documentation are anecdotal and do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of query language reference docs beyond a one-line LogQL description, documented query languages for metrics and traces in this pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of ad-hoc analysis.

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language

citations.quote: Explore your data through ad-hoc queries and dynamic drilldown.
LogQL is Grafana Loki's query language. LogQL uses labels and operators for filtering.
enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored
